presets.difference: R17 supplies opaque and transparent edge techniques. Its 10px border and source colors are not defaults. R15 motivates an optional scene only; the default has no mesh/noise or animated gradient.
presets.light: A low-alpha decorative cool/warm edge around neutral opaque bodies.
presets.dark: A somewhat stronger colored edge without lifting the page or coloring the ink.
states: Existing state edge/body only; gradient stops stay fixed.
Hide optional gradient edge; active body and required edge remain.
Keep selection colors; do not recolor a progress/range core with the gradient.
presets.sourceStatus: reference-inspired authored proposal; not native parity or approved Area preset

page.guard: Keep existing page body (near-black in dark); no self-cast, blur, transmitted page, or inherited scene. Optional artwork is a separate declared scene, off by default.
page.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

container.guard: Only an actual painted shell; layout wrappers stay unpainted. Dense body is opaque Trace; perimeter can be Quiet. Respect Card/Panel or no-cast binding.
container.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

floating-surface.guard: Quiet shell, one acquisition and one existing cast owner. Tooltip reduces to Trace and its own opaque recipe. Arrow continues shell with no separate effects.
floating-surface.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

raised-control.guard: Quiet only for sparse actions, Trace for repeated actions; no external cast. Transparent/ghost/row controls keep their existing lack of body until state paints it.
raised-control.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

recessed-field-track.guard: Trace, opaque editing/reading center. Only local cavity; focus/invalid are separate. Track and well geometry unchanged.
recessed-field-track.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

thumb-knob.guard: Quiet local convex cue, original dimensions/travel, Surface shadow-1 only where already bound; no independent backdrop.
thumb-knob.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

indicator-fill.guard: Semantic/literal core unchanged and opaque as already specified. Trace optional halo only outside truthful data geometry and with clearance; none on literal color data.
indicator-fill.provenance: authored-proposal; see preset source transfer record

divider.guard: Existing structural line stays. Trace supplementary relief only; no cast, grain or glow network.

edge.guard: This is the owner shell perimeter reference, not a second edge pass. Required control/focus/invalid edges bypass Material. Surface decorative width may disable this edge.

statePolicy.hover: Existing state edge/body only; gradient stops stay fixed.
statePolicy.press: Hide optional gradient edge; active body and required edge remain.
statePolicy.focus-visible: Keep required focus; remove optional glow, gloss and reflected body overlays on the focused receiver.
statePolicy.selected-checked: Keep selection colors; do not recolor a progress/range core with the gradient.
statePolicy.open: Resolve the opened receiver independently, one shell; preserve actual expanded state.
statePolicy.disabled: Use existing disabled paint once and opaque body; remove optional glow/gloss/relief/grain/gradients/strokes, keep selected value.
statePolicy.invalid: Keep danger context and combined invalid-focus geometry; suppress optional glow/gloss, reflected body overlays and decorative edge gradient.
